description: Fixion cutscene benchmark seed cases (6 from Josh's 5 scenarios + 20 new). Preliminary.
coordinate_system: integer (x,y), x east, y south, origin top-left of map file incl. border
seed_policy: Every handcrafted case is its own seed: seed_id == id. A perturbed or synthetic variant keeps its parent's seed_id (and records generator model, perturbation type and filters). Dev/test/hidden splits are assigned per seed_id, so variants of one seed never straddle a split.
split_policy: dev: open, iterate freely. test: run at checkpoints only, never pasted into prompts or used as synthetic seeds. hidden: kept private (not in this public file), run only by Josh for go/no-go; no tuning loop, human or agent, sees it.

global_judge_questions.q: Do the # narrative comments describe only effects that the following instructions actually perform (no effects that exist only in comments)?
Does every character act only on information they could actually have (heard speech, visible state, history)?
Is the size of the reaction proportional to the player's input?
Is anything stated or implied that contradicts the final world state?

cases.title: Bartender walks to the customer's column
